description.zh:
需要删除的防火墙规则名称。支持输入多个规则名称进行批量删除，多个名称间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
> 您可以通过[DescribeFirewallRules](~~212573~~)接口查看目标集群下所有防火墙规则的详情，包括规则名称。
description.en:
The names of the firewall rules to delete. You can specify multiple rule names. Separate the names with commas (,).

> Call the [DescribeFirewallRules](~~212573~~) operation to query the details of all firewall rules for the cluster, including the rule names.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb delete-firewall-rules --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --rule-name-list testrule --region cn-hangzhou
